about.body: The AJ16 is Jaguar's 4.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, produced from 1994 to 1997. It was fitted exclusively to the XJ X300 generation - the last of Jaguar's traditional straight-six engines before the brand moved to V8 power. The AJ16 is a robust, well-regarded engine that remains one of the most respected powerplants from the Ford-era Jaguar transition.

byModel.body: The AJ16 appeared exclusively in the XJ X300 generation as the XJ6 variant. This was the final iteration of Jaguar's legendary inline-six, and it represents the culmination of decades of straight-six development.

compatibility.body: The AJ16 was used exclusively in the XJ X300 generation - meaning compatibility is straightforward for this particular engine code. However, even within a single application, ancillaries and mounting may vary by specification and year. items.heading: AJ16 in the XJ (X300, 1994-1997)
items.body: The AJ16 in the XJ X300 is the application we work on for this engine. This was the final generation of the Jaguar XJ to use the classic inline-six, and it remains a sought-after engine for its smoothness and character.
